extra_messages.content: You have an iron pickaxe and strong gear, so push into deeper caves to find diamond and gold ore. Retreat to safety if mobs overwhelm you, then craft the best tools you can.
Move deeper underground cautiously, tunneling downward near your furnace while watching for lava. Mine any diamond or gold you spot immediately, prioritizing survival over speed.

You have an iron pickaxe and furnace, so dig straight down to find diamond and gold ore at the lowest cave levels. Don't waste steps fighting mobs or exploring sideways—tunnel downward efficiently and mine any ores you see immediately.

Explore existing cave passages downward rather than digging straight down - lava pools indicate diamond depth. Keep your iron pickaxe ready and mine any blue or gold speckled stone immediately, avoiding mob fights to save time.
Descend to the deepest cave levels near lava to find diamond and gold ore, mining any blue or yellow deposits immediately. Defeat any zombies you encounter along the way to unlock that achievement.

Dig straight down to the deepest level and mine any diamond or gold ore you find immediately. Don't waste time exploring side passages or fighting mobs - focus purely on reaching the lowest depths where diamond spawns near lava.
You have 130 steps, so dig straight down to the deepest cave levels near lava where diamond and gold ore spawn. Ignore side passages, saplings, and mobs unless they directly block your path to ore.
Skip all side activities and dig straight down to the deepest lava levels where diamond and gold ore spawn. Mine any precious ore you find immediately and ignore everything else.
